learning_outcomes.description: Apply pharmacological and therapeutic principles in the management of skin cancer and associated conditions.
Critically analyse therapeutic options to ensure evidence-based, safe, and patient-centred prescribing.
Engage with prescribing guidelines and public health frameworks to support equitable access to treatments.
Recognise cultural, economic, and social factors in therapeutic planning, especially in vulnerable populations.
Communicate treatment plans clearly to support patient understanding, adherence, and informed consent.
Model professional accountability and ethical conduct in therapeutic decision-making.

assessments.assessment_title: Clinical Skills Videos and Case Presentation
assessments.task_description: Six clinical skills videos and one clinical presentation is submitted to the discussion board approximately each fortnight. Students then comment about the presentations on the discussion board. The videos will provide 24/30 for the grade, and the clinical presentation 6/30 of the grade making a 30/30 total.
